tool.title: Build a bean drain queue
tool.description: Read every bean copy, keep the drainable open beans (task, bug, feature in todo or in-progress, not blocked, not owner-held), group them by the owner already working in that area, mark the ones another agent touched within the window as skip, and list everything left out with its reason and every bean whose copies disagree. The newest updated_at wins where copies disagree.

inputs.name: copy
inputs.description: A local checkout of a bean copy, fetched by the tool to its bean ref. Repeat once per copy. Defaults to the current checkout.

inputs.name: holdings
inputs.description: A JSON file mapping each owner to the bean ids it holds (`holdings` in the skill's input schema).

inputs.name: agents
inputs.description: A JSON file of the agents and their commit authors (`agents` in the skill's input schema). Defaults to the table in the bean-drain skill.

inputs.name: window
inputs.description: Another agent's commit within this window marks a bean skip. Defaults to 24h.

inputs.name: json
inputs.description: Emit the queue as JSON matching `definitions.queue`, instead of Markdown.

outputs.name: queue
outputs.description: The queue: sources with the tip each was read at, one section per owner in priority order, the spare pool, the excluded beans with reasons, and the copies that disagree. With --json, the same as `definitions.queue` of schemas/skills/bean-drain/output.schema.json. A copy that cannot be fetched is an error, never an empty queue.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: With --json, the queue as one `DrainQueue` record: sources, owner sections in priority order, the spare pool, exclusions and disagreeing copies. Programs read this; people read `queue`.

selection.when: Starting or refreshing a drain with more than one agent, or giving an idle drainer its next beans.
selection.limits: It proposes; it does not claim. Every bean taken from it still goes through `bean-claim-check`. Owner-held is read from the last note's wording and can miss; a person reviewing the queue is the backstop. For one agent picking one bean, `bean-query` named `safe_drain_candidates` is enough.
selection.cost: One fetch per copy and one `git log` per open bean. No GitHub API calls.

remedies.none: With no fetch, the queue is built from the copies as last fetched, and the output says how old each tip is.

$comment.comment:
The Tool node for building a bean drain's queue.

Bean `n7x7`, skill `bean-drain` step 1. On 2026-10-24 a drain thread built
this queue by hand, from two bean copies and a list of who held what, into a
shared file, and refreshed it as threads finished. The steps were right; doing
them by hand meant each refresh re-derived the exclusions slightly
differently. The output contract is `definitions.queue` in
`schemas/skills/bean-drain/output.schema.json`.

@module work-plan/tools/drain-queue
